requires_tools.instructions: Determine whether fulfilling this user request requires executing external tools (files, terminal, web, schedule) or if a direct conversational response is appropriate.

criteria.true: Executing shell, reading or writing files, web queries, interacting with system or background tools
criteria.false: Pure conversational reply, greeting, general reasoning or explanation without tool execution

tool_decision.instructions: Determine whether external tools or terminal execution are required to fulfill the user request, or if direct conversational response is appropriate.

criteria.direct_chat: Conversational reply, reasoning, code explanation without tool execution
criteria.execute_tools: Executing shell, reading or writing files, web queries, or interacting with tools

category.instructions: Select the primary category of tool required for this task.

criteria.filesystem: File operations: reading, writing, editing, listing or patching files
criteria.terminal_execution: Running bash, terminal, shell commands, scripts and process execution
criteria.web_and_search: Web browsing, fetching remote URLs, downloading pages and online searches
criteria.schedule: Timers, background alarms, daily or cron schedules and reminders
criteria.system: System utilities, git repositories, workspace configuration and status

difficulty.instructions: How demanding is it to complete this turn well?

costly_mistake.instructions: A wrong or sloppy answer or destructive command here would be costly or hard to undo.

criteria.true: System alteration, destructive commands, file modifications, git push, deployment
criteria.false: Read-only inspection, search, conversational answer, explanation
